name: Soluble solids content
description: Sugar concentration of the fruit, normally reported in degrees Brix. Recorded as a separate trait because Brix figures are published by owners, by independent trials and by registries using different sampling points in the season, and are frequently quoted without a method.

attributes.comparability_note: Owner marketing figures, single-point measurements and season-long trial means are not interchangeable. Compare only where method, site and season are stated.
